articles.title: Djokovic Loses to Hurkacz in Shanghai Days After Winning in Beijing
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic lost to Hubert Hurkacz for the first time in nine meetings at the Shanghai Masters, just three days after winning the China Open.

articles.title: BTS Star RM Shares His Art Collection, and Fans Flock to the Museum
articles.summary: BTS leader RM is showing his personal art collection at the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art, drawing crowds of fans, some visiting an art museum for the first time.

articles.title: Zoo Lions Act More Like Wild Lions With a Feast-and-Fast Menu
articles.summary: An Australian study found zoo lions given occasional whole-animal meals ate, rested and moved in patterns much more like wild lions.
